script.title: REPORTING A STOLEN PORCH PACKAGE
script.scene_zh: 大樓門口 · 追查包裹
script.intro_zh: 我放在門廊的包裹一夜之間不見了。
script.welcome_en: Hello friends, welcome back! Today: a package that went missing.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨朋友們，歡迎回來！今天的主題：不見了的包裹。
script.outro: Hope your packages stay put. Listen again and see you next time!
script.outro_zh: 希望你的包裹都乖乖待在原地。多聽幾遍，我們下次見！
script.practice_intro_en: Now it's your turn: read each line with me.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在換你跟著我，一句一句朗讀。
script.char_a_description: a heavyset Korean man in his mid forties with cropped graying hair at the sides, wearing a charcoal windbreaker and a baseball cap, shifting his weight impatiently
script.char_b_description: a petite Indian woman in her early thirties with long braided black hair, wearing a teal cardigan over a white blouse with a lanyard key ring, typing briskly on her tablet
script.youtube_title: 【📦🚪包裹失竊英文】「請調監視器」怎麼說？18句追件對話，經理幫你要回來🎥｜Stolen Package English
script.youtube_title_en: “There's a Person in Gray” — Reporting a Stolen Porch Package
script.youtube_description:
包裹送到門口卻人間蒸發？這段18句的追件對話，教你向管理員確認送達時間、調閱監視器畫面、報警備案、向賣家申請補發或退款，一次學齊。整段自然美式口語，附繁體中文翻譯與 IPA 標音，後半段逐句跟讀，聽完就知道怎麼處理。
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
訂閱我們的頻道，每天一集，讓英語變成你的直覺！
script.youtube_description_en:
Package marked delivered but gone from your porch? This 18-line conversation shows you how to confirm the delivery time, pull camera footage, file a police report, and ask the shop for a replacement or refund. Natural American English with IPA and translation, then repeat every line out loud in the second half.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🏠包裹失竊英文｜確認送達・調監視器・報案與退款｜聽完就會追件｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
明明顯示送達，門口的包裹卻不見了？
該先找管理員、警局，還是賣家？

這一集帶大家走進公寓大廳，住戶向管理員反映包裹失竊，兩人一起確認送達時間、調閱監視器、鎖定可疑人物，再決定報案與向賣家申請退款的下一步，全程都是自然的美式英語。

你會聽到：
📦 確認送達：例如「it says delivered at six forty-five, right here」。
🎥 調閱畫面：例如「let's check the cameras」、「there's a person in gray」。
🧾 後續處理：例如「ask them for a replacement or a refund」、「send them the clip and the report number」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

收貨難免有意外，聽完這一集，失竊處理不慌張！
script.thumbnail_action: pointing at a lobby camera monitor

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Someone stole my package off my porch last night.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌmwʌn stoʊl maɪ ˈpækɪdʒ ɔf maɪ pɔrtʃ læst naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 有人昨晚從我門廊偷走了我的包裹。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh no! Did the app say it was delivered?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ dɪd ði æp seɪ ɪt wəz dɪˈlɪvərd/
dialogue.zh: 哦不！配送軟體有顯示送達嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, it says delivered at six forty-five, right here.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɪt sɛz dɪˈlɪvərd ət sɪks ˈfɔrti faɪv raɪt hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 有，上面寫六點四十五分送到，就在門口。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, what was inside, and was it expensive?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ wʌt wəz ɪnˈsaɪd ænd wəz ɪt ɪkˈspɛnsɪv/
dialogue.zh: 好的。裡面裝的是什麼？貴重的東西嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It was my son's birthday gift, about eighty dollars.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt wəz maɪ sʌnz ˈbɜrθˌdeɪ ɡɪft əˈbaʊt ˈeɪti ˈdɑlərz/
dialogue.zh: 是我兒子的生日禮物，大約八十塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's so frustrating. Let's check the cameras.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts soʊ frʌˈstreɪtɪŋ lɛts tʃɛk ðə kæˈmərz/
dialogue.zh: 太讓人生氣了。我們來調監視器畫面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great idea. Is there one that faces my door?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt aɪ.də ðɛrz wʌn ðət ˈfeɪsɪz maɪ dɔr/
dialogue.zh: 好主意。有沒有對著我家門口的鏡頭？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the lobby camera covers that whole side.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə ˈlɑbi kæm.rə ˈkʌvərz ðæt hoʊl saɪd/
dialogue.zh: 有的，大廳那臺涵蓋你那整側。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could we watch from six fifteen to seven?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd wi wɑtʃ frʌm sɪks ˈfɪfˈtin tə ˈsɛvən/
dialogue.zh: 可以給我們看六點十五到七點的畫面嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pulling it up now. Hmm, there's a person in gray.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊlɪŋ ɪt ʌp naʊ həəm ðɛrz ə ˈpɜrsən ɪn ɡreɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我現在調出來。嗯，有個穿灰色衣服的人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See? He just grabs it and walks right off.
dialogue.phonetic: /si hi dʒʌst ɡræbz ɪt ænd wɔks raɪt ɔf/
dialogue.zh: 看到了吧？他拿起包裹就直接走掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll report this to the police with the video.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl rɪˈpɔrt ðɪs tə ðə pəˈlis wɪð ðə ˈvɪdioʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我會帶著這段影片去警局報案。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I contact the shop, too?
dialogue.zh: 我也有必要聯絡賣家嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, ask them for a replacement or a refund.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs æsk ðɛm fɔr ə rɪˈpleɪsmənt ɔr ə rɪˈfʌnd/
dialogue.zh: 對，請他們補寄一份或是退款。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll send them the clip and the report number.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl sɛnd ðɛm ðə klɪp ænd ðə rɪˈpɔrt ˈnʌmbər/
dialogue.zh: 我會把影片片段和報案編號傳給他們。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good plan. And packages now wait in our office.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd plæn ænd ˈpækɪdʒz naʊ weɪt ɪn ˈaʊər ˈɔfɪs/
dialogue.zh: 好對策。之後包裹都會先放在我們辦公室。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Really? That's a relief. Thanks for everything.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrɪli ðæts ə rɪˈlif θæŋks fɔr ˈɛvriθɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？那就讓人放心了。謝謝你這一切的幫忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anytime. Keep me posted on that refund!
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛnɪˌtaɪm kip mi ˈpoʊstɪd ɑn ðæt rɪˈfʌnd/
dialogue.zh: 不客氣。退款有消息記得告訴我！
